name: @stapel/attributes-react
description: React value layer for stapel-attributes' dynamic feature types: a value-editor registry keyed on config.type (explicit registration > skin builtin > loud unsupported notice, with the submit blocked and the reason named), a client-side validation mirror that speaks the engine's own error.400.feature_* keys (pattern as fullmatch, string length in Unicode code points), DTO helpers for the {slug: {type, value}} wire shape, and display formatting. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd editors for all ten builtin types plus <FeatureFields> and <FeatureBadges>.

size-limit.name: index — the registry + mirror + DTO helpers must stay React-only: no antd (8 → 8.5 KB: the eleven picker keys and their English floor ride in the shared bundle; → 8.75 KB: the step-ladder predicates a host asks BEFORE it draws — visible rows, visible blocks, missing required; → 9 KB: the popular-band readers on the vocabulary seam and the two band headings in the English floor)

default — the antd value editors must stay out of the main bundle (16 → 17.5 KB: progressive disclosure and the bake write-backs on the fields, the vocabulary-backed int editor with its stepper/suggestion combo, and paging on every picker sheet; → 18.75 KB: the BOUNDED int — keypad, dropdown of the allowed values, steppers and the moved-bound reset — which is the mechanism a year field had prose for; → 19 KB: the ceiling above was set from a measurement taken mid-change and came up 68 B short of the finished one. Re-measured with dependencies held constant, this package's src at the commit before the chip/bounded-int fix and then at it: 18.49 -> 18.82 KB. The 330 B is the bounded int saying WHICH state it is in — at a bound, past a moved bound, off the allowed set — in text a screen reader reads rather than in a disabled stepper, plus the chip that now carries its own label. A control that refuses a value has to say which rule it is refusing under, and that sentence is markup, not prose in a doc)
i18n/ru — the Russian bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry
i18n/es — the Spanish bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry
